exams.name: CSI Certified Construction Contract Administrator (CCCA)
exams.blurb: Certifies administration of construction contracts, changes and closeout documentation.

exams.name: CSI Certified Construction Products Representative (CCPR)
exams.blurb: Certifies representatives in construction products, specifications and project delivery.

exams.name: CSI Certified Construction Specifier (CCS)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification for professionals who write and manage construction specifications.

exams.name: CSI Construction Document Technician (CDT)
exams.blurb: Certifies knowledge of construction documents, contracts and the specification process.

exams.name: PHIUS Certified Passive House Builder
exams.blurb: Credential for builders and contractors constructing passive house projects to PHIUS standards.

exams.name: PHIUS Certified Passive House Consultant (CPHC)
exams.blurb: Credential for designing and consulting on passive house buildings to PHIUS climate-specific standards.

exams.name: PHIUS Certified Passive House Designer
exams.blurb: Credential for designers modelling and detailing passive house envelopes and mechanical systems.

exams.name: IPC Certified Interconnect Designer (CID)
exams.blurb: Credential for printed circuit board designers covering layout and documentation standards.

exams.name: IPC Certified Interconnect Designer+ (CID+)
exams.blurb: Advanced credential for senior PCB designers covering complex high-speed and multilayer design.

exams.name: IPC-A-610 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS)
exams.blurb: Credential for inspectors of electronic assemblies per the IPC-A-610 acceptability standard.

exams.name: NCIDQ Interior Design Fundamentals Exam (IDFX)
exams.blurb: First NCIDQ exam testing design fundamentals, design elements and programming for interior designers.

exams.name: NCIDQ Interior Design Professional Exam (IDPX)
exams.blurb: Second NCIDQ exam testing building systems, codes and professional practice for interior designers.

exams.name: NCIDQ Practicum (PRAC)
exams.blurb: Third NCIDQ exam testing applied interior design solutions through a scenario-based practicum.

exams.name: SITES AP
exams.blurb: Credential on sustainable land design and development via the SITES rating system.

exams.name: TRUE Advisor
exams.blurb: Credential on zero waste strategies and the TRUE certification for waste diversion programmes.

exams.name: WELL Accredited Professional (WELL AP)
exams.blurb: Credential on the WELL standard for human health and wellness in the built environment.

exams.name: WELL Faculty
exams.blurb: Advanced credential recognising experts who educate and advocate for WELL building principles.

exams.name: ASME GDTP Senior (Y14.5)
exams.blurb: Senior credential covering advanced geometric dimensioning and tolerancing application.

exams.name: ASME GDTP Technologist (Y14.5)
exams.blurb: Credential covering geometric dimensioning and tolerancing fundamentals per ASME Y14.5.

exams.name: Certified SOLIDWORKS Associate (CSWA)
exams.blurb: Entry credential demonstrating basic mechanical design and SOLIDWORKS software skills.

exams.name: Certified SOLIDWORKS Professional (CSWP)
exams.blurb: Advanced credential demonstrating complex part, assembly and drawing modelling in SOLIDWORKS.

exams.name: SMRP Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP)
exams.blurb: Credential covering maintenance strategy, reliability engineering and asset management.

exams.name: SMRP Certified Maintenance & Reliability Technician (CMRT)
exams.blurb: Credential for technicians in preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and reliability practices.

exams.name: EDGE Expert
exams.blurb: Credential certifying green buildings in emerging markets using the EDGE resource-efficiency standard.

exams.name: Green Globes Professional (GGP)
exams.blurb: Credential for assessing and guiding projects through the Green Globes rating system.

exams.name: Living Future Accredited (LFA)
exams.blurb: Credential on the Living Building Challenge and regenerative, net-positive design principles.

exams.name: NGBS Green Professional
exams.blurb: Credential on the National Green Building Standard for residential green building verification.
